market_definition: The antidiabetic apis market covers sales of active drug substances used to manufacture medicines in the indicated therapeutic or chemical class. It measures API supply to pharmaceutical manufacturers, not sales of finished medicines. BY DRUG CLASS: Metformin and other biguanides, Sulfonylureas and meglitinides, DPP-4 inhibitors, SGLT2 inhibitors, Thiazolidinediones. BY MANUFACTURING ROUTE: Chemical Synthesis, Biocatalysis, Semi-Synthesis. BY REGULATORY FILE: US DMF, CEP, Other DMFs. BY CUSTOMER PORTFOLIO: Generic Products, Branded Products, Specialty Products. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Only the active ingredient is counted for Antidiabetic APIs; formulated medicines, excipients and contract service fees are outside this market. Other API classes are excluded unless the molecule falls within the named category. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / WHOLESALER: a distributor, wholesaler, trader, importer or stockist that buys these products from their makers and sells them to pharmaceutical manufacturers. EXCLUDED companies: product makers and their own sales subsidiaries, and companies selling only the excluded products.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
